_note: Inputs to scripts/build-data.ts. Sources are pinned by commit and SHA-256. Header values are fictional except where noted. The original Study, Series and SOP Instance UIDs are replaced because the same files are published in jmandel/my-health-data and seeded as the project's public sample share under their original UIDs; reusing those UIDs for a different patient identity would make two different patients claim the same instances. New UIDs are minted deterministically under the 2.25 root from uidNamespace and the original UID (see scripts/lib/dicom-rewrite.ts, mintUid).

report.title: MRI BRAIN
report.techniqueIntro: Multiplanar, multisequence MR imaging of the brain.
findings: Brain parenchyma: No mass, mass effect or midline shift. No restricted diffusion on the diffusion-weighted images and ADC maps.
Hemorrhage: No intracranial hemorrhage on the T2* gradient-echo images.
Ventricles and extra-axial spaces: Ventricles and sulci are normal in size and configuration. No extra-axial collection.
Vessels: Normal major intracranial flow voids.
Other: The visualized paranasal sinuses and mastoid air cells are clear.
